## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T20:54Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1 + `target:v18`:** the printed invoice does not carry its own number (INV-1010 is on neither PDF). A print page refuses `page:header`, so nothing else draws the title field. The maintainer's rule 「PDF 要赶 18.0 正式版」 puts the PDF chain at p1.
- **For the claimant:** Re-read on `main` `ed43c79ce5`: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx:752`–`:753` still hides `declaredTitleField` whenever the record has a value. On a print page, the field stays. Re-render the PDF (both routes) as the acceptance reading.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (`target:v18` · `priority:p1`; filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 from objectui#12751's report as not a claim, graded by the triage seat, `6224507284`, on the maintainer's 「PDF 要赶 18.0 正式版」)
Session: `session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`
Account: `os-sales` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12787-print-title-field`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12787` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#4`
File surface: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx` (the page-header title dedupe, about :735–775 on `main` `f114263`), tests beside it under `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/`, one `.changeset/12787-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (cloud on the maintainer's stance 「可以的话，ui 后续开发尽量用云 session，并且要求截图给我看」; lane scope on 「你也可以接ui车道的卡」; batch 3 on 「当前任务处理完，后续并发降到3」, this session's chat, 2026-10-16)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: measured on `main` `f114263`: `RecordDetailsRenderer` is on `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s entry, but the change is behaviour inside it: it reads the existing `usePrintPage()` from `@object-ui/react` (already read by `DetailView`, `DetailSection` and `LineItemsPanel`) and adds no prop, no type member and no key. A change that has to touch a published face stops and is reported under `deviations`, and the seat amends this claim.
Responsibility: n/a — a measured print-page defect on the PDF chain
Thread-read: 6224507284
Serial constraints cleared: the open `plugin-detail` PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12796 (objectui#12741, another seat) edits `RelatedList.tsx` and `renderers/record-related-list.tsx` only. objectui#12751 (the approval band, `DetailView.tsx`) landed as `6367bfe`, and objectui#12759 (inline date edit) as `020d178`. No open objectui PR touches `record-details.tsx` (read at dispatch).
